name: GND
description: Ground; must be soldered to RF ground (Pin Functions: GND Pins 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, Exposed Pad Pin 13)

name: IF
description: Single-ended IF port; internally to IF transformer primary, low DC resistance to ground (~6.2 ohm); series DC block 'should be used' if DC present; matched 500MHz to 9GHz

name: RF
description: Single-ended RF port; internally to RF transformer primary, DC-grounded (~2.5 ohm); series DC block 'must be used' to avoid damage if DC present; matched 3GHz to 20GHz

name: EN
description: Enable; >1.2V on, <0.3V off; internal 376k pull-down (floating = disabled); never exceed VCC+0.3V

name: VCC
description: Supply 3.3V regulated (3.0-3.6V), bypass cap close to pin; 132mA typ

name: LO
description: LO input, 50 ohm 1-20GHz; series DC block must be used (C1=18pF); pin DC ~1.6V

name: GND
description: Exposed pad, printed pin 13, GND; must be soldered to PCB (electrical + thermal)
